title: Pueblo y líder
goal: Read a critical look at populism's central mechanism -- the direct leader-people bond, who "the people" actually excludes, and radio's role -- alongside what this bond genuinely meant for millions.

items: Describe the central political mechanism populism sets in motion.
Explain why it's questionable whether "the people" corresponds to the whole population.
State why many political scientists find the leader-masses relationship concerning.
Explain radio's role in making this direct bond possible.
Use es cuestionable que + subjunctive to evaluate a debatable claim.
